Mr. R.S. Bisht, Additional C.S.C. for

Petitioners claim that wait list is not 
being prepared for appointment to the 
position of Assistant Teachers (Primary), 
District Udham Singh Nagar.
Today, when the matter is taken up, 
learned State Counsel would submit that, 
in fact, wait list has already been prepared 
in the month of August, 2024.
Let the wait list be placed for the 
perusal of the Court tomorrow.
 (Ravindra Maithani J.)

10S WPSS No. 832 of 2025
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Dushyant Mainali, Advocate for 
the petitioners.
Mr. Ganesh Kandpal, D.A.G. for the 
State.
Heard.
Today, learned State counsel gives a 
statement that the waiting list has already 
been prepared and second counseling was 
done on its basis.
Learned counsel for the petitioners 
would submit that till the vacancies are 
filled for a particular period, the waiting 
list should be kept alive and the candidates 
should be called for counseling.
The Court wanted to know from 
learned State counsel as to whether all the 
positions have been filled up?
He seeks time to get instruction on 
this aspect.
List on 12.06.2025.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 22.05.2025
Jitendra

1. Mr. Nikhil Bhatt, learned counsel for the 
petitioners.
2. Mr. S.S. Chaudhary, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has 
relied upon the Rules dealing with “Waiting 
List”, which was notified on 10.10.2023.
4. Learned State Counsel shall get 
instructions as to whether the said Rules are 
applicable to the selection in question or not. 
If the answer to the said question is in the 
negative, then the reason for non-application 
of the said Rules shall also be indicated.
5. List this case on 13.04.2026.
